summary: Implemented A11Y-3: surface-aware focus tokens, semantic 4.5:1/3:1 contrast auditing, 44 px target auditing, an install-level motion preference with an Appearance toggle that defaults to the OS setting and persists an explicit reduce choice, reduced-motion CSS/board hand-off for pin/string/auto-pan/page/pulse, and 98 targeted tests; full suite, typecheck, lint, format, and build pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented A11Y-3: surface-aware focus tokens, semantic 4.5:1/3:1 contrast auditing, 44 px target auditing, an install-level motion preference with an Appearance toggle that defaults to the OS setting and persists an explicit reduce choice, reduced-motion CSS/board hand-off for pin/string/auto-pan/page/pulse, and 98 targeted tests; full suite, typecheck, lint, format, and build pass.
decisions: The OS reduce-motion request is a hard floor; the Appearance toggle can add a persisted reduce choice but cannot re-enable full motion against the platform setting. The control is checked and disabled with an explanatory note when the device asks for reduced motion.

A shared motion store applies data-motion on the document root; base.css contains both a media-query fallback for the pre-hydration frame and a [data-motion='reduced'] rule for immediate in-app changes.

Focus rings are surface-aware: the existing light ring covers dark surfaces and new dark rings cover sepia paper and the amber status chip; the OCR suggestion quiet button now uses paper ink so it is readable on paper.

Named motion-intent classes (pin drop, string draw, auto-pan, page transition, pulse) are applied to the board, route main, and status badge so future animations cannot bypass the reduced-motion rule.
Auto-pan is an instant camera jump in v1; motionBehavior(true).autoPan is 'instant' and the board stage exposes data-motion-auto-pan='instant'.
interfaces: src/app/motionPreference.ts exports MOTION_ATTRIBUTE, MOTION_PREFERENCE_ATTRIBUTE, MOTION_STORAGE_KEY, MOTION_ANIMATION_CLASSES, MotionStore, createMotionStore, motionStore, ensureMotionPreference, useMotionPreference, and motionBehavior.
SettingsPage({ hintStore?, motionStore? }) adds the Appearance 'Reduce motion' checkbox.
BoardCanvas({ ..., motionStore? }) forwards the shared preference to usePixiApp and exposes data-motion/data-motion-auto-pan.

The product is a single dark theme; the 'both themes' criterion was implemented as dark surfaces plus the sepia paper reading surface, with separate focus-ring tokens for each.
docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl and docs/WORKFLOW-STATE.json were already engine-modified and were not touched.
validationLimitations: No real-browser geometry measurement of 44 px targets or focus-ring rendering was run; evidence is CSS-contract plus jsdom fixtures, with actual geometry owned by the responsive and axe Playwright gates.
The board camera auto-pan is already an instant jump in v1, so reduced motion removes the category rather than shortening an existing tween.
payload.taskDescription: Audit and update tokens.css, base.css, and SettingsPage. Add an Appearance motion toggle that defaults to prefers-reduced-motion, persists an explicit override, and applies immediately. Remove pin drop, string draw, auto-pan, page transition, and pulsing animations when reduced motion is active. Add tests that compute contrast for all semantic text/background pairs, audit interactive target sizes in component fixtures, and assert the motion setting disables animation classes and auto-pan. Do not add axe scans or performance tests.
